tools.name: Trade Risk Analyzer
tools.description:
Get a heads-up on muggers! 

This doesn't prevent mugs or do anything automatic. It's purely informational. Whether you trade or not is 100% your call. Always hosp yourself during a trade just to be safe, this script just gives you a heads up so you remember to do it when dealing with a risky partner. Some players might seem safe but still mug you, some players will seem risky and not mug you. Always self-hosp.
